mapper.select: SELECT c.cluster_id AS clusterId, COUNT(*) AS userCount, ROUND(AVG(p.total_payment_amount), 2) AS avgAmount, ROUND(AVG(p.total_order_count), 1) AS avgOrders, ROUND(AVG(p.browse_count_30d), 1) AS avgBrowse, ROUND(AVG(p.login_count_30d), 1) AS avgLogin, -- 簇内用户分层的众数（业务主导分层，用于动态命名簇；画像重算后自动跟随） -- 按 (segment_code, segment_name) GROUP BY 兼容 sql_mode=only_full_group_by (SELECT sg.segment_code FROM user_segment sg JOIN user_cluster cc ON cc.user_id = sg.user_id WHERE cc.cluster_id = c.cluster_id GROUP BY sg.segment_code, sg.segment_name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1) AS dominantSegment, (SELECT sg.segment_name FROM user_segment sg JOIN user_cluster cc ON cc.user_id = sg.user_id WHERE cc.cluster_id = c.cluster_id GROUP BY sg.segment_code, sg.segment_name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1) AS dominantSegmentName FROM user_cluster c LEFT JOIN user_profile_summary p ON p.user_id = c.user_id GROUP BY c.cluster_id ORDER BY c.cluster_id

SELECT u.id AS userId, u.user_code AS userCode, u.gender AS gender, u.age AS age, u.province AS province, s.segment_name AS segmentName, COALESCE(p.total_payment_amount, 0) AS totalPaymentAmount, COALESCE(p.total_order_count, 0) AS totalOrderCount FROM user_cluster c JOIN ecommerce_user u ON u.id = c.user_id LEFT JOIN user_profile_summary p ON p.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN user_segment s ON s.user_id = u.id WHERE c.cluster_id = #{cluster} ORDER BY totalPaymentAmount DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_cluster WHERE cluster_id = #{cluster}
SELECT MAX(data_version) AS dataVersion, MAX(calculated_at) AS calculatedAt FROM user_cluster
